## Solutions to Simplify Your Business

Discover our innovative technology and services designed to simplify operations, reduce costs, and
maximize your efficiency.

## Simplify Your Ordering Process

Order online anytime, track deliveries, and manage your inventory with ease using Gordon Ordering.

[Learn More >][25]

## On The Go With Our App

The Gordon Now App lets you place orders, browse products, and manage your account right from your
mobile device.

[Learn More >][26]

## Optimize Your Menu Management

Gordon Restaurant Pro helps you control costs, plan menus, and analyze sales data to maximize
profitability.

[Learn More >][27]

## Find the Right Tech for Your Restaurant

Navigate hundreds of tech options to discover the best fit for your operations—plus, access to
exclusive deals.

[Explore All Solutions >][28]

## Delivering Quality & Expertise

Explore our wide range of products and services designed to enhance your operations and delight your
customers.

## Quality Ingredients, Delivered On Time

We offer a wide selection of fresh, frozen, and dry goods to meet all your menu needs.

[**Explore Products**][29]

## Reliable Distribution Network

Our established distribution network ensures your orders are delivered on time and ready for
application.

[**Learn More**][30]

## Trusted Brands, Exceptional Value

Discover our exclusive brands that help you cut costs without sacrificing quality.

[**View Our Brands**][31]

## Specialized Solutions for Your Needs

Our specialty companies provide tailored solutions for specific foodservice tastes and operational
needs.

[**Learn More**][32]

## Essential Equipment & Supplies

Find a comprehensive selection of kitchen equipment, tabletop items, and supplies.

[**Browse Supplies**][33]

## Innovative Technology Solutions

Streamline your operations with our user-friendly online ordering, inventory management, and menu
planning tools.

[**Explore Technology**][34]

## Culinary Expertise & Support

Access culinary resources, trends, and expert advice to inspire your menu and enhance your
offerings.

[**Explore Support**][35]

## Committed to Sustainability

We offer sustainable products and practices to help you reduce your environmental impact.

[**Learn About Sustainability**][36]

## A Legacy of Excellence

With over 125 years of experience, Gordon Food Service is a trusted partner for foodservice
businesses across North America.

CAREERS

## Start Your Future
## With Us Today

Whether you are looking to work with your hands in operations, jump behind the scenes in the Home
Office, or serve our customers directly in transportation and sales, we have a place for you! We
welcome individuals with unique perspectives and talents. With a variety of positions available,
explore our careers and apply today if you find a role that fits your passion!

[ Explore Careers ][37]
[ See Open Positions ][38]

## Your Source for Industry Insights

We provide valuable resources to help you adapt, innovate, and thrive in the ever-evolving
foodservice landscape.

[ Become a Customer ][39]
[ Explore Trends & Ideas ][40]

## Connect & Discover at Our Food Shows

Stay informed about upcoming food shows and events to network and discover new products.

[Find a Show Near You >][41]

## Stay Informed with Industry Insights

Get the latest trends, research, and analysis to make informed business decisions.

[Read the Insights >][42]

## Inspire Your Menu with New Recipes

Find innovative recipes, menu ideas, and culinary inspiration to delight your customers.

[Get Inspired >][43]

## Optimize Your Strategy & Operations

Improve efficiency, manage costs, and enhance your business strategy with expert guidance.

[Learn More >][44]

See how we have helped foodservice businesses thrive through partnership and tailored solutions.

## We are Novolex

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging servicing customers
across a wide range of industries, including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food
processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors.

With an extensive and innovative product portfolio, we help businesses operate efficiently, meet
evolving customer expectations, and deliver everyday essentials to millions of consumers around the
world.

## Join our team

At Novolex, our people are at the heart of Packaging for a Better Future through choice, innovation,
and sustainability. We offer opportunities to grow, learn, and contribute in meaningful ways across
our manufacturing facilities, offices, and distribution centers. Explore our open roles and see how
you can be part of our growing organization.

[ View Jobs ][26]

## Community

As a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging, Novolex is uniquely positioned
to help address food insecurity and support the communities where we live and work. Our company-wide
Month of Action is one way we empower our teams to give back. Through local volunteer efforts and
charitable contributions, employees support the organizations and causes that matter most to them
and their families.

[ Learn More ][27]

## Choice, Innovation, & Sustainability

[Product Choices for Your Business Needs]

### Product Choices for Your Business Needs

Novolex offers one of the industry’s broadest portfolios of packaging solutions designed to
safeguard, preserve, and showcase food and beverages for customers across diverse markets.

[ View Products ][28]
[ Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers]

### Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers

As market needs evolve, Novolex provides material and product choices that support performance,
sustainability, and speed-to-market. Our teams of material scientists and engineers enable us to
help customers transition to more sustainable alternatives efficiently and effectively.

[Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet]

### Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet

We fulfill the Novolex promise of choice, innovation and sustainability beginning with the materials
we select. Over time, we have expanded the diversity of substrates used across our product lines to
meet both functional requirements and customer sustainability goals.

## We are Novolex

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging servicing customers
across a wide range of industries, including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food
processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors.

With an extensive and innovative product portfolio, we help businesses operate efficiently, meet
evolving customer expectations, and deliver everyday essentials to millions of consumers around the
world.

## Join our team

At Novolex, our people are at the heart of Packaging for a Better Future through choice, innovation,
and sustainability. We offer opportunities to grow, learn, and contribute in meaningful ways across
our manufacturing facilities, offices, and distribution centers. Explore our open roles and see how
you can be part of our growing organization.

[ View Jobs ][26]

## Community

As a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging, Novolex is uniquely positioned
to help address food insecurity and support the communities where we live and work. Our company-wide
Month of Action is one way we empower our teams to give back. Through local volunteer efforts and
charitable contributions, employees support the organizations and causes that matter most to them
and their families.

[ Learn More ][27]

## Choice, Innovation, & Sustainability

[Product Choices for Your Business Needs]

### Product Choices for Your Business Needs

Novolex offers one of the industry’s broadest portfolios of packaging solutions designed to
safeguard, preserve, and showcase food and beverages for customers across diverse markets.

[ View Products ][28]
[ Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers]

### Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers

As market needs evolve, Novolex provides material and product choices that support performance,
sustainability, and speed-to-market. Our teams of material scientists and engineers enable us to
help customers transition to more sustainable alternatives efficiently and effectively.

[Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet]

### Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet

We fulfill the Novolex promise of choice, innovation and sustainability beginning with the materials
we select. Over time, we have expanded the diversity of substrates used across our product lines to
meet both functional requirements and customer sustainability goals.

Experience tailored solutions from a committed team dedicated to delivering results and earning your
trust.

[RESOURCE HUB][90]

PausePlay

Packaging Applications

## Custom Corrugated Packaging for Every Application

The versatility of corrugated makes it an ideal choice for creating packaging solutions that meet
every need.

[

Contain

The rigors of the road and environmental factors can lead to product damage. Distribute and store
your products with confidence, knowing that PCA engineers designed your packaging to meet your
unique demands.  Learn more about corrugated shipping containers.

][91][

Protect

Sometimes your product requires more than an outside container to help it arrive at its destination
safely. Explore our advanced interior packaging designs for creative solutions.

][92][

Promote

High-impact packaging can grab attention, build brand recognition, and drive sales. PCA offers a
wide variety of print methods that enable your packaging to inform, educate and promote your message
no matter your budget.

][93]

## A box isn’t just a box. Your packaging impacts your entire operation.

Productivity, warehousing space and transportation costs can all be affected by your packaging.
Select custom corrugated packaging to fit every specification and budget.

[
[By Service Icon][By Service Icon]

By Service

range of services will set you up for success.

][94]
[
[By Need Icon][By Need Icon]

By Need

contain, transport, protect, inform and promote your product.

][95]
[
[By Industry Icon][By Industry Icon]

By Industry

breadth of experience guide you to the ideal solution.

][96]

Sustainable Packaging Solutions

## Corrugated is the most environmentally friendly packaging in the world.

Corrugated packaging is made from a renewable resource grown in managed forests and is the most
recycled packaging material. PCA is also committed to:
* Energy efficiency
* Renewable energy resources
* Responsible design, manufacturing and delivery

A partnership with PCA isn’t just about buying boxes. Our employees are dedicated to building
relationships, providing quality products and delivering an outstanding service experience. At PCA,
our people make the difference.

resources–

# Made in the USA 

Our custom pouches, roll stock, other custom products offer the perfect combination of versatility,
sustainability, and quality. Made with eco-friendly materials and in stock for quick delivery, these
custom pouches and bags can be tailored to your specific needs, whether you're in the food, beauty,
or any other industry. The reviews don't lie -- our custom pouches are simply the best! 

### Elevate Your Brand With CarePac's Custom Pouches

## CarePac Pouch Bags & Pouches: the highest level of customization

### Totally Customized Pouches

No fixed sizes, customize every detail of your pouch: size, material, features, print, and
configurations. Enterprise level flexible packaging customization available to every company. 

### CareDesign Service

Need help with art setup on your boxes? Bring what you have and we'll do the rest. The most
personalized art support in the industry, comes free with every custom order!

 

### Offering Digital & Plate Printing 

No one solution fits all. We don't steer you towards a particular solution. Instead, our goal is to
meet your brand where it is today and be there for you as you scale and each step of the way.

various sizes, shapes, and custom materials to suit different product types

# Made in the USA 

Our custom pouches, roll stock, other custom products offer the perfect combination of versatility,
sustainability, and quality. Made with eco-friendly materials and in stock for quick delivery, these
custom pouches and bags can be tailored to your specific needs, whether you're in the food, beauty,
or any other industry. The reviews don't lie -- our custom pouches are simply the best! 

### Elevate Your Brand With CarePac's Custom Pouches

## CarePac Pouch Bags & Pouches: the highest level of customization

### Totally Customized Pouches

No fixed sizes, customize every detail of your pouch: size, material, features, print, and
configurations. Enterprise level flexible packaging customization available to every company. 

### CareDesign Service

Need help with art setup on your boxes? Bring what you have and we'll do the rest. The most
personalized art support in the industry, comes free with every custom order!

 

### Offering Digital & Plate Printing 

No one solution fits all. We don't steer you towards a particular solution. Instead, our goal is to
meet your brand where it is today and be there for you as you scale and each step of the way. 

[ Get A Quick Quote ][291]
[ Shop Stock ][292]

From shelf stable and frozen food to pet food, health and wellness, and cosmetics, custom pouch
packaging is designed to meet the unique requirements of different industries. They are available in
various sizes, shapes, and custom materials to suit different product types
and storage conditions.

# We rethink packaging every day.

We are Constantia Flexibles, a global leader in consumer and pharmaceutical flexible packaging.

[Find out more][30]

## Pharma Business

Together with our partners, we protect health and ensure the safety of patients and their loved
ones.

[About Pharma][31]

## Consumer Business

We aim to provide people with the highest benefit daily at the lowest impact on the environment.

[About Consumer][32]

## People Passion Packaging

Based on the guiding principle of People Passion Packaging, we globally manufacture tailor-made
flexible packaging solutions.

## We Design for Recycling

With more than 110 years of experience in flexible packaging, we know that high‑quality and visually
appealing packaging is only part of the story. Today, packaging also needs to work within modern
recycling systems and meet evolving customer expectations.


That’s why we apply Design for Recycling principles across our development processes. Our
**Ecolutions portfolio** includes flexible packaging solutions engineered to support established
recycling streams wherever possible. These products are designed to perform strongly, protect goods,
and be handled more efficiently at end‑of‑life within available infrastructure.
 

By continuously improving material choices, design features, and production technologies, we help
customers move toward packaging that aligns with the requirements of tomorrow’s markets.

Jobs & Career

## Your career at Constantia Flexibles

No matter if you want to start or to further develop in your career, Constantia Flexibles offers
meaningful jobs that contribute to a better tomorrow, creating packaging solutions that protect
goods and the environment and save lives. Explore our job opportunities and learn more about us.

[Career at Constantia][33]

## Explore our culture

At Constantia Flexibles, we are passionate about what we do and want to play a part in making
tomorrow’s world a better place. Find out more about our culture, our core values and whom do we
seek on board.

[ Learn more ][34]

## Job openings

Join us and unwrap your talent!

[ Apply ][35]

# We rethink packaging every day.

We are Constantia Flexibles, a global leader in consumer and pharmaceutical flexible packaging.

[Find out more][30]

## Pharma Business

Together with our partners, we protect health and ensure the safety of patients and their loved
ones.

[About Pharma][31]

## Consumer Business

We aim to provide people with the highest benefit daily at the lowest impact on the environment.

[About Consumer][32]

## People Passion Packaging

Based on the guiding principle of People Passion Packaging, we globally manufacture tailor-made
flexible packaging solutions.

## We Design for Recycling

With more than 110 years of experience in flexible packaging, we know that high‑quality and visually
appealing packaging is only part of the story. Today, packaging also needs to work within modern
recycling systems and meet evolving customer expectations.


That’s why we apply Design for Recycling principles across our development processes. Our
**Ecolutions portfolio** includes flexible packaging solutions engineered to support established
recycling streams wherever possible. These products are designed to perform strongly, protect goods,
and be handled more efficiently at end‑of‑life within available infrastructure.
 

By continuously improving material choices, design features, and production technologies, we help
customers move toward packaging that aligns with the requirements of tomorrow’s markets.

Jobs & Career

## Your career at Constantia Flexibles

No matter if you want to start or to further develop in your career, Constantia Flexibles offers
meaningful jobs that contribute to a better tomorrow, creating packaging solutions that protect
goods and the environment and save lives. Explore our job opportunities and learn more about us.

[Career at Constantia][33]

## Explore our culture

At Constantia Flexibles, we are passionate about what we do and want to play a part in making
tomorrow’s world a better place. Find out more about our culture, our core values and whom do we
seek on board.

[ Learn more ][34]

## Read Our Product Specifications

Your product deserves better packaging than a flimsy one. Every dented corner and crumpled lid of
the packaging quietly destroys customer trust in your brand. In such a case, the use of **custom
rigid packaging **is not a luxury. It is a necessity to amplify your brand identity.

At Custom Rigid Packaging, we manufacture set-up boxes that protect the product and create a
memorable unboxing experience. From 800gsm jewelry boxes to 2000gsm electronics packaging, every box
ships with your exact dimensions and exact colors.

## **What Are Custom Rigid Boxes? **

The brand invests thousands in their products with perfection. Their branding is in shape, and their
product is of high quality. But the moment customers receive a flimsy packaging with dents, they get
a negative impression of your brand. All the high-end brands use **custom rigid packaging boxes
**based on a fundamental trust, which is that the packaging is a part of the product. These boxes
are manufactured with premium-quality greyboard or chipboard cores that are wrapped in art or
textured paper. A rigid packaging does not collapse or bend.

Compared to standard folding cartons, rigid setup boxes are 4× thicker. These boxes are manufactured
to survive freight handling and retail shelving. Due to the premium nature, **custom rigid packaging
solutions **are the most preferred ones by the following brand:
* Luxury retail
* Boutique fashion
* Fine jewelry
* Luxury watches
* Premium cosmetics and skincare
* Consumer electronics and tech accessories
* Corporate gifts
* Subscription boxes
* Chocolates and artisan food gifts

### **Outer Wrapping Papers**

For **custom rigid boxes designs**, outer wrapping papers are required that can create a catchy
appearance. The core material cannot be printed due to high porosity. That is why external wraps are
applied, which can be from the following:
* **Art paper:** This paper has a GSM range of 128 to 157. Art paper is used for crisp prints and is
  ideal for CMYK artwork with photographic images.
* **Kraft paper: **It gives an organic and tactile look to the boxes. Artisan brand perfect kraft
  paper.
* **Speciality metallic paper**: Some brands prefer paper material that gives mirror-like shoes and
  is used for extra luxury boxes.
* **Velvet or suede paper: **For soft touch and premium feel, velvet or suede paper is used. The
  common applications of this paper are in cosmetic or perfume boxes.

## **Material Options With GSM Ranges For Product Compatibility**

Our **custom rigid boxes wholesale **service has identified one of the biggest mistakes that brands
make. This is choosing a chipboard weight that does not match the product’s actuarial need. Every
brand uses the best quay material for [**custom flip top boxes**][75], but fails to understand the
actuarial needs of its products. Some of the best material options based on product requirements are
as follows:

────────────────┬─────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
GSM Range       │Thickness    │Best For                                                             
────────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
800gsm to       │1.2mm to     │• Small jewellery boxes                                              
1000gsm         │1.5mm        │• Cosmetic inserts                                                   
                │             │• Lightweight retail packaging                                       
────────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
1200gsm to      │1.8mm to     │• Mid-size apparel boxes                                             
1400gsm         │2.2mm        │• Candles                                                            
                │             │• Skincare sets                                                      
────────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
1600gsm to      │2.5mm to     │• Electronics                                                        
1800gsm         │3.0mm        │• Premium corporate gifting                                          
────────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
2000gsm+        │3.2mm+       │• Ultra-luxury watch boxes                                           
                │             │• Heavy product sets                                                 
                │             │• Heirloom packaging                                                 
────────────────┴─────────────┴─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## **Select The Right Box Style For Your Brand**

Selection of the right box is mandatory to get the best product presentation and protection. A right
box ensures that you create a professional impression on customers and that you are not spending
extra on the wrong box style.

### **Two-Piece Lid And Base **

It is one of the common styles of rigid packaging. **Two-piece rigid boxes **have a fully separate
base and lid. All the premium retail packaging boxes can be manufactured in this easy-to-pack box
style. Custom [**two piece rigid boxe****s**][76] offer maximum interior display space and
effortless unboxing. Common examples are jewellery boxes and apparel boxes.

### **Magnetic Flip-Top Closure**

This is a single-piece box that has a hinge lid, which is reinforced by concealed neodymium magnets.
**Magnetic closure rigid boxes **have a snap shut closure, and the sound alone gives a premium
quality. [**Magnetic rigid boxes**][77] drive a viral unboxing experience and help you get free
promotion. Subscription boxes and electronic boxes are common examples of this.

### **Drawer Boxes**

This style of **foldable rigid boxes **has an outer sleeve and an inner sliding tray. Draw boxes are
easy to handle and give a premium feel. Tech accessories and luxury chocolate boxes come in this box
style.

### **Shoulder And Neck Boxes **

In our **custom rigid boxes manufacturer **services, you will find this option as well. Shoulder
neck boxes have an inner neck tray that sits slightly above the base perimeter. This creates a
visible and elegant frame lid and casts a memorable impression on customers. You can select this box
style for watch boxes and premium fragrances.

### **Collapsible Rigid Box**

E-commerce brands use **collapsible rigid boxes **to perfectly accommodate their product in a small
space. [**Collapsible rigid packaging**][78] resolves the logistical issue of space as they are
shipped flat and can be assembled in seconds.

## **Printing Methods For A Custom Look **

At our company, we design the boxes with the printed design of your choice so you can get a unique
identity in the market. With **custom rigid boxes with logo **brands get a free promotional tool. A
rigid box is not about brand promotion, but it is about leaving a lasting impression on the
customers with a unique artwork and box appearance. That is why we give our custom minimalist
multi-colour printing via PMS and CMYK colours.
* Offset Printing
* Digital Printing
* Screen Printing

## Read Our Product Specifications

Your product deserves better packaging than a flimsy one. Every dented corner and crumpled lid of
the packaging quietly destroys customer trust in your brand. In such a case, the use of **custom
rigid packaging **is not a luxury. It is a necessity to amplify your brand identity.

At Custom Rigid Packaging, we manufacture set-up boxes that protect the product and create a
memorable unboxing experience. From 800gsm jewelry boxes to 2000gsm electronics packaging, every box
ships with your exact dimensions and exact colors.

## **What Are Custom Rigid Boxes? **

The brand invests thousands in their products with perfection. Their branding is in shape, and their
product is of high quality. But the moment customers receive a flimsy packaging with dents, they get
a negative impression of your brand. All the high-end brands use **custom rigid packaging boxes
**based on a fundamental trust, which is that the packaging is a part of the product. These boxes
are manufactured with premium-quality greyboard or chipboard cores that are wrapped in art or
textured paper. A rigid packaging does not collapse or bend.

Compared to standard folding cartons, rigid setup boxes are 4× thicker. These boxes are manufactured
to survive freight handling and retail shelving. Due to the premium nature, **custom rigid packaging
solutions **are the most preferred ones by the following brand:
* Luxury retail
* Boutique fashion
* Fine jewelry
* Luxury watches
* Premium cosmetics and skincare
* Consumer electronics and tech accessories
* Corporate gifts
* Subscription boxes
* Chocolates and artisan food gifts

### **Outer Wrapping Papers**

For **custom rigid boxes designs**, outer wrapping papers are required that can create a catchy
appearance. The core material cannot be printed due to high porosity. That is why external wraps are
applied, which can be from the following:
* **Art paper:** This paper has a GSM range of 128 to 157. Art paper is used for crisp prints and is
  ideal for CMYK artwork with photographic images.
* **Kraft paper: **It gives an organic and tactile look to the boxes. Artisan brand perfect kraft
  paper.
* **Speciality metallic paper**: Some brands prefer paper material that gives mirror-like shoes and
  is used for extra luxury boxes.
* **Velvet or suede paper: **For soft touch and premium feel, velvet or suede paper is used. The
  common applications of this paper are in cosmetic or perfume boxes.

## **Material Options With GSM Ranges For Product Compatibility**

Our **custom rigid boxes wholesale **service has identified one of the biggest mistakes that brands
make. This is choosing a chipboard weight that does not match the product’s actuarial need. Every
brand uses the best quay material for [**custom flip top boxes**][75], but fails to understand the

## **Select The Right Box Style For Your Brand**

Selection of the right box is mandatory to get the best product presentation and protection. A right
box ensures that you create a professional impression on customers and that you are not spending
extra on the wrong box style.

### **Two-Piece Lid And Base **

It is one of the common styles of rigid packaging. **Two-piece rigid boxes **have a fully separate
base and lid. All the premium retail packaging boxes can be manufactured in this easy-to-pack box
style. Custom [**two piece rigid boxe****s**][76] offer maximum interior display space and
effortless unboxing. Common examples are jewellery boxes and apparel boxes.

### **Magnetic Flip-Top Closure**

This is a single-piece box that has a hinge lid, which is reinforced by concealed neodymium magnets.
**Magnetic closure rigid boxes **have a snap shut closure, and the sound alone gives a premium
quality. [**Magnetic rigid boxes**][77] drive a viral unboxing experience and help you get free
promotion. Subscription boxes and electronic boxes are common examples of this.

### **Drawer Boxes**

This style of **foldable rigid boxes **has an outer sleeve and an inner sliding tray. Draw boxes are
easy to handle and give a premium feel. Tech accessories and luxury chocolate boxes come in this box
style.

### **Shoulder And Neck Boxes **

In our **custom rigid boxes manufacturer **services, you will find this option as well. Shoulder
neck boxes have an inner neck tray that sits slightly above the base perimeter. This creates a
visible and elegant frame lid and casts a memorable impression on customers. You can select this box
style for watch boxes and premium fragrances.

### **Collapsible Rigid Box**

E-commerce brands use **collapsible rigid boxes **to perfectly accommodate their product in a small
space. [**Collapsible rigid packaging**][78] resolves the logistical issue of space as they are
shipped flat and can be assembled in seconds.

At our company, we design the boxes with the printed design of your choice so you can get a unique

[Easy Green Eco Packaging Mission][142]

According to relevant researches, people around the world are changing their way to eat, such as
eating more kinds of food, in more places, and in more ways than before. And allwe mentioned above
is actually bringing us a great numbers of challenges and chances.



Under this circumstances, Easy Green, named after the goal that we go green in an easy way, was
created in 2009 as an eco-friendly packaging company and quickly earned reputation in international
market. As one of the most professional biodegradable food packaging manufacturers and biodegradable
food packaging companies, we aim to offer proper package for 252 ( love what I love ) kinds of
different foods. Not only do we want to make food look great, but we want to keep it safe and
sustainable too.



Today, we continue to uphold the same mission to be of service to customers and consumers in all
that we do. We carry this in our business operations to address sustainability in our eco friendly
disposable food packaging products and practices.

## Norfersk: Demonstrating the impact of Faerch’s circular tray solutions

As global demand grows for circular food packaging, Faerch continues to advance food-grade recycling
at scale through its CIRPET+™ material, produced from recycled former food packaging. One of the
leading examples of this progress is the transition implemented by Norfersk, a major Norwegian fresh
meat producer. 

[Read more][84]
[
[Smukfest circular cup initiative]
][85]
Circular projects

## Smukfest circular cup initiative

In 2024, Smukfest in Denmark set an ambitious goal to collect 75% of its festival cups for
recycling. Partnering with Royal Unibrew, Dansk Retursystem, and Faerch, the festival not only met
but exceeded expectations, achieving an impressive 95% collection rate of over one million cups used
during the festival week.

[Read more][86]
[
[Danish Crown embraces circularity with green meat trays]
][87]
Fresh Meat and Protein

## Danish Crown embraces circularity with green meat trays

In 2024, global meat producer Danish Crown began replacing 55 million black meat trays in Denmark
with green Evolve by Faerch trays. Made from at least 90% recycled content, these trays are fully
recyclable and compatible with existing recycling systems – an important milestone in achieving
circular packaging.

[Read more][88]
[
[Agromousquetaires converting to recyclable PET trays]
][89]
Fresh Meat and Protein

## Agromousquetaires converting to recyclable PET trays

For several years, Agromousquetaires, leading manufacturer of private labels and the fifth largest
agri-food group in France, has worked with Faerch to transition its food packaging trays from XPS,
EVOH and PE trays to mono-material APET.

[Read more][90]

][91]

* [Get in touch with us][66]
* [Learn about built-in absorbers][67]

## recycleduo2_carousel

# RecycleDuo™ meets dairy

### Packaging designed for today's recycling systems
* [Get in touch with us][68]
* [RecycleDuo™ with self separation][69]

## RM_test01_carousel

# CPET built for ready meals

### Oven-safe performance for convenience-led meals
* [Get in touch with us][70]
* [Find out how CPET supports ready meals][71]

Faerch - your trusted partner

## Future proofing your food packaging 

Faerch is a leading supplier of recyclable rigid food packaging with integrated recycling
capabilities.
We support food producers and retailers globally with solutions that keep food safe, extend shelf
life, and reduce food waste.


[See how we can help your business][72]

Preserve and protect food

## We offer packaging solutions for various markets

Dairy

Protect freshness, extend shelf life and present your products clearly with reliable, food-safe
packaging designed for dairy applications, supporting efficient production, strong shelf appeal and
evolving sustainability expectations.

[Dairy][73]

Fresh meat and protein

Maintain product integrity from processing to shelf with packaging that protects freshness, supports
food safety and enhances presentation, helping meet retailer needs while reducing waste.

[Fresh meat/protein][74]

Foodservice and QSR

Serve safely with durable packaging for fast-paced environments, delivering reliable performance,
consistent quality and formats for takeaway, delivery and in-store dining.

[Foodservice/QSR][75]

Food to go

Deliver convenience and quality with packaging that keeps food fresh, secure and appealing on the
move, helping you meet consumer expectations for portability, visibility and ease of use.

[Food to go][76]

Produce

Protect precious produce, while showcasing natural freshness with packaging designed to preserve
quality, minimise waste and support efficient handling across the supply chain, from packing to
retail display.

[Produce][77]

Ready meals

Enable convenient, high-quality meal experiences with packaging that performs across chilling,
heating and handling, preserving taste and freshness while supporting efficient production and
strong on-shelf presentation.

[Ready meals][78]

## Herkkumaa transitions from glass to DuoSmart™ PP

Herkkumaa, a leading Finnish producer of preserved vegetables, jams, sauces, and mayonnaises, has
taken a significant step toward reducing the environmental footprint of its packaging. 

[Read more][82]
[
[Norfersk: Demonstrating the impact of Faerch’s circular tray solutions]
][83]
Fresh Meat and Protein

## Norfersk: Demonstrating the impact of Faerch’s circular tray solutions

As global demand grows for circular food packaging, Faerch continues to advance food-grade recycling
at scale through its CIRPET+™ material, produced from recycled former food packaging. One of the
leading examples of this progress is the transition implemented by Norfersk, a major Norwegian fresh
meat producer. 

[Read more][84]
[
[Smukfest circular cup initiative]
][85]
Circular projects

## Smukfest circular cup initiative

In 2024, Smukfest in Denmark set an ambitious goal to collect 75% of its festival cups for
recycling. Partnering with Royal Unibrew, Dansk Retursystem, and Faerch, the festival not only met
but exceeded expectations, achieving an impressive 95% collection rate of over one million cups used
during the festival week.

[Read more][86]
[
[Danish Crown embraces circularity with green meat trays]
][87]
Fresh Meat and Protein

## Danish Crown embraces circularity with green meat trays

In 2024, global meat producer Danish Crown began replacing 55 million black meat trays in Denmark
with green Evolve by Faerch trays. Made from at least 90% recycled content, these trays are fully
recyclable and compatible with existing recycling systems – an important milestone in achieving
circular packaging.

[Read more][88]
[
[Agromousquetaires converting to recyclable PET trays]
][89]
Fresh Meat and Protein

## Agromousquetaires converting to recyclable PET trays

For several years, Agromousquetaires, leading manufacturer of private labels and the fifth largest
agri-food group in France, has worked with Faerch to transition its food packaging trays from XPS,
EVOH and PE trays to mono-material APET.

[Read more][90]

In a time marked by a focus on innovation, precision, reliability, automation, and sustainability
within the food industry, a partnership between two industry leaders has led to a revelation:
Faerch's patented Ultra Low Stacking trays*.*

Our Introduction

# Food Industry Council for Skills and Innovation

FICSI has created a vibrant ecosystem that includes standards, model curriculum and learning
resources, a network of affiliated training centres and Vocational Colleges, supported by industry
experts master trainers and assessors for providing industry relevant skills. The National Council
for Vocational Education & Training (a regulatory body under the Union Ministry of Skill Development
and Entrepreneurship) has recognised FICSI as an awarding body.

* Our Mission

# Your Packaging Concierge

At Freedom Packaging, we redefine what it means to be a packaging manufacturer.

More than rigid and flexible packaging, we’re your trusted partner delivering custom packaging
solutions with unparalleled service. As your packaging concierge, we guide you from concept to
delivery, ensuring your brand stands out while meeting your business needs.

 

[Let us assist you][17]

Why Choose Us

## Best-in-Class Service, Every Step of the Way

[two women meeting at a table]

### Seamless Process

Our team makes your packaging process seamless. With up to 180-day warehousing and pay-on-ship
billing, Freedom Packaging aligns with your schedule while reducing inventory carrying costs by up
to 30%. Our min/max inventory management optimizes your supply chain with precision, ensuring you’re
never overstocked or underprepared—keeping operations running smoothly and efficiently every day.

[specs of a package from front, side, back view]

### Innovative Design & Production

Creativity meets functionality at Freedom Packaging. Expert packaging design and graphic design
teams craft visually stunning, practical solutions that elevate your brand. From initial concepts to
prepress, every detail ensures your packaging is print-ready and market-ready with 0.25% defect
rates—four times better than industry standard. With 4-6 week lead times, your vision comes to life
faster.

[trees in a forest]

### Sustainability That Delivers

Committed to a greener future, we offer sustainable packaging solutions that reduce environmental
impact without compromising quality. Free on-site trials let you explore eco-friendly materials and
innovative designs, and test solutions before full-scale production. We empower you to make
responsible choices that resonate with conscious consumers, and have helped customers transition
packaging from 100% landfill to 100% recyclable.

## The Markets We Serve

[frozen food in bowl]

### Frozen Food Packaging

Durable, freezer-safe frozen food packaging designed to protect products while maintaining brand
appeal throughout the cold chain.

[Read More][18]

[person in field holding lettuce ]

### Fresh Food Packaging

Specialized fresh food packaging solutions that keep produce, meats, and dairy fresh, appealing, and
market-ready with sustainable materials and expert design.

[Read More][19]

[pet food in puch]

### Pet Food Packaging

Premium pet food packaging solutions for dog and cat food brands that ensure freshness, enhance
shelf appeal, and build trust with pet owners.

[Read More][20]

[Cannabis Packaging in pouch]

### Cannabis Packaging

Compliant, child-resistant cannabis packaging that protects product integrity while meeting
regulatory requirements and elevating your brand.

[Read More][21]

[Digital flexible packing converters]

### Digital Flexible Packing Converters

High-quality unprinted roll stock designed specifically for digital presses and flexible packaging
converters, delivering reliable results every time.

[Read More][22]

Combining cutting-edge technology, creative expertise, and a customer-first approach, Freedom
Packaging delivers custom packaging solutions that work for you. With an average customer tenure of
14+ years and 99-100% vendor satisfaction scores, our packaging concierge service simplifies your

## Hengmaster

From Supermarkets to Dining Tables，The Scenario Solution for Food Trays
1. Fresh Food Tray (PET/PP Material) 
2. Frozen Food Packaging Box
3. Pastry Box
4. Salad Box

[Fresh Food Tray (PET/PP Material) ]
Corely adapted to three scenarios: supermarket fresh food areas, community vegetable markets, and
online fresh food e-commerce distribution. It is specially designed for fresh ingredients such as
fresh meat, fish and shrimp, fruits and vegetables, and cooked food. PET material has excellent
light transmittance, which can clearly show the fresh color and appearance of ingredients, allowing
consumers to intuitively judge the quality and enhance purchase willingness. PP material has
outstanding low-temperature resistance, suitable for refrigerated environments, and features high
toughness and impact resistance, which can avoid extrusion damage during transportation and
handling. Sealed with plastic wrap, it can extend the fresh-keeping period, perfectly matching the
supermarket's standardized packaging and consumers' "take-and-go" shopping habits. It also supports
multi-layer stacking, saving storage and shelf space.

##### Fresh Food Tray (PET/PP Material) 

[Frozen Food Packaging Box]
Focused on four scenarios: frozen food production enterprises, supermarket freezers, home
refrigeration and cold chain transportation. It can hold low-temperature foods such as quick-frozen
dumplings, steaks, frozen fruits and vegetables, and seafood. PP material has a wide temperature
resistance range (-18℃ to 120℃), which is not easy to deform or crack after repeated freezing and
thawing, and can withstand extreme temperature differences during cold chain transportation. The box
structure is designed for stacked storage, allowing multi-layer placement in supermarket freezers
without collapse. At the same time, it has strong sealing performance, which can isolate cold air
loss and external pollution, ensuring stable quality of frozen food throughout the entire
circulation chain.

##### Frozen Food Packaging Box

[Pastry Box]
Suitable for scenarios including cake shops, bakeries, dessert takeout and holiday gifts. It can
hold various pastries such as mousse cakes, cookies, macarons and fruit tarts. Made of PET material
with a light transmittance of over 95%, it acts like an "invisible display window" that fully
presents the exquisite shape, gradient colors and delicate texture of pastries. It creates a visual
impact when displayed in windows, stimulating consumers' purchase desire. The box can be customized
with a lid, and some are equipped with independent compartments for easy packaging of pastries with
different flavors. It is not only suitable for display in bakeries but also can be used as gift
packaging, balancing appearance and practicality.

##### Pastry Box

[Salad Box]
Focused on scenarios including cooked food takeout, bakery retail, supermarket prepared meals and
light meal catering. It is suitable for various ready-to-eat foods and baked goods such as salads,
sandwiches, cookies and sliced fruits. Adopting an integrated hinge design, the box lid is
seamlessly connected with the box body, and combined with a lock structure to form an airtight seal,
which can effectively lock the moisture and flavor of food and avoid leakage during takeout
transportation. The unique tear-open design has an anti-theft effect, and it cannot be resold after
opening, which improves food safety. At the same time, it is easy to take and can be opened easily
without additional tools, adapting to the needs of office meals, outdoor picnics, takeout delivery
and other scenarios.Made of PET material with a high light transmittance of over 95%, consumers can
intuitively see the fresh appearance of the food inside.

## Hengmaster

From Supermarkets to Dining Tables，The Scenario Solution for Food Trays
1. Fresh Food Tray (PET/PP Material) 
2. Frozen Food Packaging Box
3. Pastry Box
4. Salad Box

[Fresh Food Tray (PET/PP Material) ]
Corely adapted to three scenarios: supermarket fresh food areas, community vegetable markets, and
online fresh food e-commerce distribution. It is specially designed for fresh ingredients such as
fresh meat, fish and shrimp, fruits and vegetables, and cooked food. PET material has excellent
light transmittance, which can clearly show the fresh color and appearance of ingredients, allowing
consumers to intuitively judge the quality and enhance purchase willingness. PP material has
outstanding low-temperature resistance, suitable for refrigerated environments, and features high
toughness and impact resistance, which can avoid extrusion damage during transportation and
handling. Sealed with plastic wrap, it can extend the fresh-keeping period, perfectly matching the
supermarket's standardized packaging and consumers' "take-and-go" shopping habits. It also supports
multi-layer stacking, saving storage and shelf space.

##### Fresh Food Tray (PET/PP Material) 

[Frozen Food Packaging Box]
Focused on four scenarios: frozen food production enterprises, supermarket freezers, home
refrigeration and cold chain transportation. It can hold low-temperature foods such as quick-frozen
dumplings, steaks, frozen fruits and vegetables, and seafood. PP material has a wide temperature
resistance range (-18℃ to 120℃), which is not easy to deform or crack after repeated freezing and
thawing, and can withstand extreme temperature differences during cold chain transportation. The box
structure is designed for stacked storage, allowing multi-layer placement in supermarket freezers
without collapse. At the same time, it has strong sealing performance, which can isolate cold air
loss and external pollution, ensuring stable quality of frozen food throughout the entire
circulation chain.

##### Frozen Food Packaging Box

[Pastry Box]
Suitable for scenarios including cake shops, bakeries, dessert takeout and holiday gifts. It can
hold various pastries such as mousse cakes, cookies, macarons and fruit tarts. Made of PET material
with a light transmittance of over 95%, it acts like an "invisible display window" that fully
presents the exquisite shape, gradient colors and delicate texture of pastries. It creates a visual
impact when displayed in windows, stimulating consumers' purchase desire. The box can be customized
with a lid, and some are equipped with independent compartments for easy packaging of pastries with
different flavors. It is not only suitable for display in bakeries but also can be used as gift
packaging, balancing appearance and practicality.

##### Pastry Box

[Salad Box]
Focused on scenarios including cooked food takeout, bakery retail, supermarket prepared meals and
light meal catering. It is suitable for various ready-to-eat foods and baked goods such as salads,
sandwiches, cookies and sliced fruits. Adopting an integrated hinge design, the box lid is
seamlessly connected with the box body, and combined with a lock structure to form an airtight seal,
which can effectively lock the moisture and flavor of food and avoid leakage during takeout
transportation. The unique tear-open design has an anti-theft effect, and it cannot be resold after
opening, which improves food safety. At the same time, it is easy to take and can be opened easily
without additional tools, adapting to the needs of office meals, outdoor picnics, takeout delivery
and other scenarios.Made of PET material with a high light transmittance of over 95%, consumers can
intuitively see the fresh appearance of the food inside.

new shippers, while importers and exporters use our platform to discover new suppliers, competitive
shifts, and untapped business opportunities.

With ImportGenius, you don’t just react to market changes—you stay ahead of them.

feeling confused about your next steps. Finding good fresh food containers shouldn’t be so hard.

We’ve developed industry-leading, high-quality food packaging and automation solutions that give
your product the superior merchandising it deserves, driving sales and success.

#### Turn Packaging into a Powerful Driver for Growth

boost shelf appeal and ensure safety with sustainability in mind.

## Providing Sustainable Pouch Packaging Solutions

[lankerpack sustainable packaging products]

[Sustainable packaging][72] entails the use of recyclable or compostable materials to produce
packaging products. It minimizes the exploitation of raw materials and helps to curb waste
pollution.

At Logos Pack, we are passionate about sustainability. We develop and create sustainable pouch
packaging using biodegradable and 100% recyclable materials. They are highly-effective,
eco-friendly, and best of all, sustainable.

Sustainable packaging is ideal for industries such as the retail and food sectors which require bulk
long-term supply of packaging. We have the capacity to keep up with such demand and are constantly
innovating to come up with even more sustainable packaging solutions.

[Know Our Sustainable Packaging][73]

[Custom Flexible Liquid Packaging][74]

## Certified Packaging Quality From a Top-class Factory

The Logos Pack factory is equipped with top-of-the-range technology that is used to develop,
produce, and quality test all our products. All production tasks are performed by well-experienced
employees who strive to ensure that every product unit matches our strict quality standards.

All our flexible packaging products are made using FDA and SGS certified raw materials. Our
production methods equally adhere to international standards of safety hence our multiple
international certifications.

[Our Quality Control System][96]

## 4 Steps of Navigating Your Custom Flexible Pouch Project
* #### Initiate your project
  
  Simply contact us with a detailed description of your desired custom flexible packaging including
  product type and any special features. Our team will respond within 24 hours.
* #### The template
  
  Our design team will suggest solutions and present to you design options as per the requirements
  you presented. You may also submit artwork or choose from our collection.
* #### Design Samples
  
  Once the design is ready we will send you a digital and a physical sample of your custom packaging
  for testing, approval, and or, any modification requests.
* #### Production and delivery
  
  After all design modifications have been made and you approve of the design, we will begin
  production. Your flexible packaging products will be delivered within 30 days.

Forming moulds are used to shape heated plastic sheets into the required product structure through
vacuum forming, pressure forming or combined thermoforming processes. They are suitable for PP, PET,
rPET, PS and other thermoformable materials, depending on the customer’s product design and machine
configuration. In a thermoforming line, the forming mould is the core tool that gives the product
its final shape, depth, rim structure, surface details and functional areas.
[ VIEW MORE ][50]
[Forming-Mould-(1)]

### Positive & Negative Pressure In-mould Cutting Mould for Food Packaging

In-mould cutting moulds, also known as trim-in-place tooling, combine forming and cutting within the
same tool or station. Instead of moving the formed sheet to a separate trim press and re-positioning
the part for cutting, the product is cut while still referenced within the forming tool. This
process concept is widely used in high-volume thermoforming because it improves trim accuracy and
reduces handling variation.
[ VIEW MORE ][51]
[Positive & Negative Pressure In-mould Cutting Mould for Food Packaging (1)]

### Cutting Mould For Thermoformed Tray Packaging

Cutting moulds are used to trim formed products from the plastic sheet after the forming process.
They are commonly applied in off-line cutting, separate cutting stations or matched thermoforming
production lines where clean product separation is required. After the product is formed, the
cutting mould follows the product outline and removes the final part from the surrounding sheet.
This process is essential for products that need accurate edges, stable dimensions and good
appearance before packing.
[ VIEW MORE ][52]

Side-trim moulds, also called side-punch tooling in some projects, are used to create openings,
vents, slots, windows, or functional cut features on the side wall or side region of a thermoformed
part. Unlike standard contour trimming, which mainly defines the outer edge of the product, side

may be performed with steel-rule cutting tools, punch-and-die systems, or separate forming and

geometry.

one production cycle, the heated sheet is formed into the product shape and then cut directly in the

product edges and stable product dimensions. Compared with a traditional process that requires
forming first and separate cutting later, in-mould cutting can reduce secondary handling and make
the whole production line more compact.

# Your go-to packaging partner

We’re Mauser Packaging Solutions—we’re everywhere you are. Our packaging is in your garage, under
your sink, used to help your car run smoothly, helping keep your food safe, and even protecting your
doctors.

As your trusted rigid packaging manufacturer, we provide reliable products and services wherever you
do business. You can take advantage of our wide range of solutions that span the full packaging life
cycle, from design to recycling, that deliver high performance and durability while minimizing your
environmental impact.

Serving global customers for over 330 combined years, we understand the importance of getting to
know your business and providing responsive support. Your dedicated representative works closely
with you to get you what you need, when you need it.

[
Put us to work
][69]

## Source locally to do business globally

We’re dedicated to helping companies like yours operate more efficiently. And with more than 170
sites around the world, our global perspective matches our reach, allowing you to benefit from an
accessible, responsive and consistent supply chain.
[
Find a location near you
][70]

## Powering your sustainability strategy

Being an environmentally conscious consumer is more important than ever, and we’re here to
help—whether you’re looking to exceed stakeholder expectations, meet environmental regulations,
achieve green business targets, or just want an introduction to sustainable products and services.
Take a look at our sustainable solutions that can help you check those boxes, while also doing
something great for your business—and the planet.
[
See how we can support your sustainability strategy
][71]

## True sustainability

We’ve been focused on sustainability long before it was a popular priority. To us, sustainability is
more than a buzzword—it’s about doing more and using less for our customers, our employees, our
communities, and our world.

This means you have access to the industry’s most innovative packaging solutions that can help you
divert waste from landfills, reduce carbon emissions, preserve natural resources and comply with
environmental regulations. Our sustainable products and services can help you meet your short- and
long-term sustainability targets—while delivering high-performance, efficiency and reliability to
advance your business goals.

[

# Your go-to packaging partner

We’re Mauser Packaging Solutions—we’re everywhere you are. Our packaging is in your garage, under
your sink, used to help your car run smoothly, helping keep your food safe, and even protecting your
doctors.

As your trusted rigid packaging manufacturer, we provide reliable products and services wherever you
do business. You can take advantage of our wide range of solutions that span the full packaging life
cycle, from design to recycling, that deliver high performance and durability while minimizing your
environmental impact.

Serving global customers for over 330 combined years, we understand the importance of getting to
know your business and providing responsive support. Your dedicated representative works closely
with you to get you what you need, when you need it.

[
Put us to work
][69]

## Source locally to do business globally

We’re dedicated to helping companies like yours operate more efficiently. And with more than 170
sites around the world, our global perspective matches our reach, allowing you to benefit from an
accessible, responsive and consistent supply chain.
[
Find a location near you
][70]

## Powering your sustainability strategy

Being an environmentally conscious consumer is more important than ever, and we’re here to
help—whether you’re looking to exceed stakeholder expectations, meet environmental regulations,
achieve green business targets, or just want an introduction to sustainable products and services.
Take a look at our sustainable solutions that can help you check those boxes, while also doing
something great for your business—and the planet.
[
See how we can support your sustainability strategy
][71]

## True sustainability

We’ve been focused on sustainability long before it was a popular priority. To us, sustainability is
more than a buzzword—it’s about doing more and using less for our customers, our employees, our
communities, and our world.

This means you have access to the industry’s most innovative packaging solutions that can help you
divert waste from landfills, reduce carbon emissions, preserve natural resources and comply with
environmental regulations. Our sustainable products and services can help you meet your short- and
long-term sustainability targets—while delivering high-performance, efficiency and reliability to
advance your business goals.

[
Sustainable solutions

Erfolg teilweise von mathematischen Entscheidungen und Wahrscheinlichkeiten ab. Spieler analysieren
Karten, kontrollieren ihre Einsätze und versuchen, den Dealer mit einer möglichst starken Hand zu
schlagen.

Zu den beliebtesten Blackjack-Varianten gehören:
* Classic Blackjack
* European Blackjack
* Atlantic City Blackjack
* Live Blackjack
* Multi-Hand Blackjack

Jede Version bietet unterschiedliche Regeln und Strategien, wodurch das Spiel langfristig
interessant bleibt.

internationale Turniere und Online-Plattformen. Poker kombiniert Strategie, Psychologie und
Wahrscheinlichkeitsrechnung auf einzigartige Weise. Professionelle Spieler investieren oft Jahre in
Training und Analyse, um ihre Fähigkeiten zu verbessern.

Entwickler integrieren ständig neue Funktionen, um das Spielerlebnis attraktiver zu gestalten.

* Freispiele
* Multiplikatoren
* Bonusspiele
* progressive Jackpots
* interaktive Animationen

* Live-Streaming-Technologien
* mobile Casino-Apps
* künstliche Intelligenz
* Blockchain-Technologien
* Virtual-Reality-Casinos

Sicherheit und Transparenz.

Branche in den kommenden Jahren Milliardenumsätze generieren wird. Bereits heute greifen mehr als 70
% aller Nutzer über Smartphones oder Tablets auf Online-Casinos zu. Besonders Live-Blackjack und
mobile Spiele verzeichnen ein starkes Wachstum.

Interessante Statistiken zum iGaming-Markt:
* der globale Online-Glücksspielmarkt wächst jährlich um über 10 %
* mobile Nutzer dominieren den Markt
* Blackjack gehört zu den beliebtesten Tischspielen weltweit
* Europa zählt zu den wichtigsten Glücksspielregionen
* Live-Casino-Spiele gewinnen kontinuierlich an Popularität

immer beliebter.“

Online-Casinos benötigen offizielle Lizenzen und müssen strenge Anforderungen erfüllen.

* Datenschutzrichtlinien

##### THE PACKAGING CONSULTANTS

### YOUR *TURNKEY* PACKING SOLUTION

Pack’n Fresh stands out among custom food packaging companies for our commitment to sustainability
and customization. We offer flexible custom food packaging
solutions, including eco-friendly options and recyclable materials. Whether you need boxes, stick
packs, standup pouches, pillow pouches, cans, jars, paper or plastic cups, gusseted pouches, 3-4
side seal bags or other packaging solutions, we deliver exceptional quality every time. Trust Pack’n
Fresh for all your packaging needs.

### Quality. Freshness. Packed for You.

[grains 01]

#### Source

At Pack’n Fresh, we begin by sourcing the highest quality ingredients and raw materials to your
exact specifications. If you prefer, you can provide your materials, each accompanied by
Certificates of Analysis (COAs). Our sourcing capabilities cover a wide range of products, including
nutritional and food products as well as packaging materials.

[service icons 03]

#### Process

Our expert team receives, identifies, and processes materials with complete traceability and
freshness. We store everything in a controlled environment, upholding the highest standards of food
safety. Processing may include blending, batching, sorting, and packaging while ensuring every
product meets your specific needs.

[grains 02]

#### Pack & Kit

Finally, we pack, label, kit (variety packs) and palletize your finished packages according to your
requirements and specifications. Our processes adhere to all food safety and quality standards,
ensuring your packages are delivered free from any physical, chemical, or biological hazards. Pack’n
Fresh guarantees your satisfaction in all services provided.

### CERTIFIED

At Pack’n Fresh, we proudly uphold the highest certifications in the industry, adhering to local,
state, federal, organizational, and global regulations. Our commitment to quality ensures that we
meet the stringent standards required for professional food packaging. Unlike others who make false
claims, our certifications reflect our deep expertise and dedication to excellence.

freshness. We store everything in a controlled environment, upholding the highest standards of food
safety. Processing may include blending, batching, sorting, and packaging while ensuring every
product meets your specific needs.

Finally, we pack, label, kit (variety packs) and palletize your finished packages according to your
requirements and specifications. Our processes adhere to all food safety and quality standards,
ensuring your packages are delivered free from any physical, chemical, or biological hazards. Pack’n
Fresh guarantees your satisfaction in all services provided.

At Pack’n Fresh, we proudly uphold the highest certifications in the industry, adhering to local,
state, federal, organizational, and global regulations. Our commitment to quality ensures that we
meet the stringent standards required for professional food packaging. Unlike others who make false
claims, our certifications reflect our deep expertise and dedication to excellence.

converting capabilities, we take your packaging to the next level.

[Contact Us][55] [What We Offer][56] [Existing Customer?][57]

## Trusted by Leading Brands

For more than 70 years, we’ve been at the forefront of packaging, delivering superior customer
experiences fueled by impactful market insights, innovative sustainable packaging products, and
rapidly scalable services that ensure our customers’ products stand out on the grocery shelves.

## Why Printpack?

[Best-In-Class Customer Service]

#### Best-In-Class Customer Service

We develop a true understanding of the customer as an organization and as individuals to build
custom packaging solutions for their brand.

[Innovative Solutions]

#### Innovative Solutions

We work with brands to create packaging that drives progress and achieves a competitive advantage in
an ever-changing market.

[Powerful Supply Chain Expertise]

#### Powerful Supply Chain Expertise

We’ll partner with you to design a customer-centric order and inventory management program to ensure
your packaging supply chain runs smoothly, efficiently and transparently - every day.

[Experts in Multiple Packaging Formats]

#### Experts in Multiple Packaging Formats

We help brands deliver custom, leading-edge package designs that stand out on the shelf in a wide
variety of markets.

[Learn About Our Process][58]

## Our Key Capabilities

Printpack leads the packaging industry in manufacturing capabilities while delivering a
best-in-class customer experience. We are committed to Preserving and Enhancing People’s Lives
through sustainability, efficient processes, and providing quality products to our customers and
consumers.

[Our-Key-Capabilities_Flexible_12.5.25_768px] [Trusted Manufacturing Capabilities in Flexible
Packaging]

#### Flexible Packaging

Our vertically integrated manufacturing approach includes flexographic, rotogravure, and digital
printing, along with extrusion and adhesive lamination capabilities.

[Our-Key-Capabilities_Rigid_12.5.25] [Specialty Rigid Packaging Innovations]

#### Specialty Rigid Packaging

Our specialty rigid packaging includes barrier co-extrusion and thermoforming capabilities.

[Our Key Capabilities_Medical_6.11.26] [Medical Packaging]

#### Healthcare Packaging

Our healthcare packaging includes header bags, peelable pouches, and forming films that protect the
integrity of medical devices and equipment.

## Value-Added Services

### Graphics and Prepress

We offer a multitude of the latest prepress technologies for exceptional print quality. Improved
color saturation, ink transfer, image highlight detail, and expanded tonal range are just a few of
the ways we can improve the visual impact of your package.

[Learn More][59]

### Analytical Lab

Our Analytical Services Facility has a state-of-the art analytics lab, a pilot plant equipped with
converting and packing machinery, and a full-service machine shop. Need pre-commercial assessment?
Lifecycle analysis? Market testing? At Printpack we specialize in bringing your innovative concepts
to life.

[Learn More][60]

### Field Service Team

The subject matter experts who make up our Field Service Team come from many manufacturing arenas.
They bring years of experience in printing, extrusion, adhesive laminating, and more. These
specialists often go above and beyond the call of duty during technical service work such as
scheduled visits, material disposition, and troubleshooting your machinery lines.

[Learn More][61]

### Innovation Sessions

Printpack’s innovation process helps brands recognize and resolve critical problems and capitalize
on opportunities. With innovation, brands can drive progress and achieve a competitive advantage in
an ever-changing market.

[Learn More][62]
[Sustainability banner PRINTPACK WEBSITE HOMEPAGE]

[Printpack Preserve]

## Sustainability

We believe that the use of sustainable materials for packaging is the future. With our dedicated
Sustainability Team, Printpack helps empower brands to align with consumer sentiment, comply with
regulations, and stand out as a sustainability leader. In developing Printpack Preserve™ packaging
structures which include recycled content, recyclable plastic, and paper, and with over 100
How2Recycle pre-qualified structures, we are committed to helping our customers not only improve
their speed to market but also meet their sustainability goals.

## Special Processes

The range of Packaging Services we offer is almost unlimited. We take all the technical jargon and
manufacturing intricacies away to make it easy for you to understand.  Please review a small range
of the most popular branding methods chosen by our clients.

[Screen printing]

Screen Printing

Screen printing is an ancient printing technique particularly suited for flat or relatively flat
surfaces. The heart of this involves a fine mesh that is tightly stretched to create cheap printing

[Ribbon & Magnet closer]

Ribbon & Magnet 

Ribbons can be used to add a touch of class. Ribbons are perfect for pairing with magnet closures
for easy opening, or for a satisfyingly smooth drawer opening.

[Emboss rigid box sivakasi]

Embossing & Debossing

Embossing makes a design stand out from your boxes. It impresses an image or logo into a surface
using an engraved metal die. This creates a raised impression. In reverse, this can create a deboss.

[Spot Uv]

Spot UV

Spot UV can make areas of your design really stand out with high gloss or matte finish. A thick
varnish uses UV light to dry it quickly on top of the print.

[Rigid box thermography]

Thermography

Thermography is a finishing process which uses heat to produce raised characters using very dense
ink then dusted with a special powder and then heated  to weld it to the paper.

[Rigid boxes foil]

Foil Stamping

Foil stamping is the process of applying metallic or foil effects on your boxes. It uses a metal
die, like a stamp -onto which the design is chemically etched or crafted by hand from supplied
artwork.

[[Innovative Plastic Cosmetic Bottles & Jars Designed for Modern Skincare Brands]][172]

##### [Innovative Plastic Cosmetic Bottles & Jars Designed for Modern Skincare Brands][173]

2026-06-30

As modern skincare and beauty brands pursue the perfect balance of minimalist aesthetics, safe
functionality, and sustainable development, rigid cosmetic packaging represented by plastic bottles
and jars has become the core packaging choice for high-end skincare, body care, and cosmetic cream
products. Different from flexible tube packaging for squeeze cosmetics, cosmetic bottles and jars
are dedicated to storing high-viscosity creams, essences, lotions, serums, and skincare treatment
products, requiring stricter sealing performance, stable barrier properties, premium visual texture,
and long-term structural durability. To meet the upgraded packaging needs of global modern skincare
brands and comply with the latest international environmental regulations, Runk officially releases
a full range of newly upgraded innovative plastic cosmetic bottles and jars — exclusively launched
on our rigid packaging official website, bringing customized, eco-friendly, and high-value rigid
packaging solutions for global beauty enterprises.

Are you a manufacturer or a trading company?
We are professional manufacturing group more than 15 years for cosmetic packaging.
What's your lead time for mass production?
For most of our products, the lead time for mass production is 20-35 days.
Will you help with shipping? Do you ship internationally?
Yes, we have clients across the world. We can arrange shipping to different countries in the world.
How does your factory do regarding quality control?
We will make PPS & range board before volume production and test them after sample approved, and
make 100% inspection during production, then do random checks before packing, finally, we will take
pictures after packing.
How can you ensure the quality of your products?
We always put quality first. From incoming raw material inspections, and the production process, to
the quality control of the final product, our IQC, IPQC and OCQ staff follow each step strictly with
a systematic measurement for quality assurance.
Does you have after-sales service?
Runk always hopes to establish stable and long-term relationships with customers, so we will always
offer our best service in every stage of business.

Our professional packaging team has arrived at COEX Seoul for the iconic 2026 InterCHARM Korea

[[Innovative Plastic Cosmetic Bottles & Jars Designed for Modern Skincare Brands]][172]

##### [Innovative Plastic Cosmetic Bottles & Jars Designed for Modern Skincare Brands][173]

2026-06-30

As modern skincare and beauty brands pursue the perfect balance of minimalist aesthetics, safe
functionality, and sustainable development, rigid cosmetic packaging represented by plastic bottles
and jars has become the core packaging choice for high-end skincare, body care, and cosmetic cream
products. Different from flexible tube packaging for squeeze cosmetics, cosmetic bottles and jars
are dedicated to storing high-viscosity creams, essences, lotions, serums, and skincare treatment
products, requiring stricter sealing performance, stable barrier properties, premium visual texture,
and long-term structural durability. To meet the upgraded packaging needs of global modern skincare
brands and comply with the latest international environmental regulations, Runk officially releases
a full range of newly upgraded innovative plastic cosmetic bottles and jars — exclusively launched
on our rigid packaging official website, bringing customized, eco-friendly, and high-value rigid
packaging solutions for global beauty enterprises.

## Quick Response

Are you a manufacturer or a trading company?
We are professional manufacturing group more than 15 years for cosmetic packaging.
What's your lead time for mass production?
For most of our products, the lead time for mass production is 20-35 days.
Will you help with shipping? Do you ship internationally?
Yes, we have clients across the world. We can arrange shipping to different countries in the world.
How does your factory do regarding quality control?
We will make PPS & range board before volume production and test them after sample approved, and
make 100% inspection during production, then do random checks before packing, finally, we will take
pictures after packing.
How can you ensure the quality of your products?
We always put quality first. From incoming raw material inspections, and the production process, to
the quality control of the final product, our IQC, IPQC and OCQ staff follow each step strictly with
a systematic measurement for quality assurance.
Does you have after-sales service?
Runk always hopes to establish stable and long-term relationships with customers, so we will always
offer our best service in every stage of business.

Beginning with the inspiring legacy of Lorilleux and Samuel Morrill in the early 1800’s, Sun
Chemical has delivered [over 200 years][114] of color expertise, innovative technology and an
ongoing commitment to quality and service for our customers.

A member of the DIC Group, Sun Chemical is a leading producer of packaging and graphic solutions,
color and display technologies, functional products, electronic materials, and products for the
automotive and healthcare industries.

sustainable solutions to exceed customer expectations and better the world around us. Spread across
17 [research and development][115] centers worldwide, we’ve been granted over 3,000 patents and are
determined to deliver the solutions you need.

# Sun Chemical is the World’s Leading Provider of Inks and Pressroom Products, Color Materials and
# Advanced Materials

### Experience. Transformation.

Beginning with the inspiring legacy of Lorilleux and Samuel Morrill in the early 1800’s, Sun
Chemical has delivered [over 200 years][114] of color expertise, innovative technology and an
ongoing commitment to quality and service for our customers.

A member of the DIC Group, Sun Chemical is a leading producer of packaging and graphic solutions,
color and display technologies, functional products, electronic materials, and products for the
automotive and healthcare industries.

Together with DIC, Sun Chemical’s 21,000+ employees are continuously working to promote and develop
sustainable solutions to exceed customer expectations and better the world around us. Spread across
17 [research and development][115] centers worldwide, we’ve been granted over 3,000 patents and are
determined to deliver the solutions you need.


## Sun Chemical's Products and Solutions

#### [ Packaging and Graphic Solutions ][116]

Sun Chemical is a recognized leader in[ printing inks, coatings, adhesives and supplies][117] for
the packaging, publication, commercial, industrial, and digital markets and introduces solutions
that enable marketers to better manage their brand colors, protect product integrity through
improvements in packaging, and introduce security features that defend against counterfeiting.

#### [ Color Materials ][118]

Sun Chemical develops a wide range of [pigments and color materials][119] for architectural,
automotive and industrial coatings, cosmetics, plastics, printing inks, agricultural, and more.
Combining its pigments with DIC’s polymers for the same industries can create superior benefits and
value for coatings formulators.

#### [ Advanced Materials ][120]

Sun Chemical and DIC produce a variety of [advanced materials][121], including liquid compounds,
solid compounds and application materials for printed circuits, printed electronics, solar modules,
digital inkjet printing, automotive components, adhesives, magnetic tapes for plastic cards and
degasification modules.

#### [ Sun Chemical Security ][122]

[Sun Chemical Security][123] is our dedicated global security solutions business unit focused on
providing a wide-range of high-quality security solutions to help protect your products from
counterfeiters.

## Sun Chemical's Unwavering Focus on Sustainability

#### Learn How Sun Chemical is Prioritizing Sustainability

Sun Chemical is constantly working to promote sustainable solutions. [Our approach][124] to
sustainability guides the way we develop, manufacture and distribute products, as well as how we
work with our customers and suppliers.

Working with industry leaders and in line with DIC Corporation’s goal to achieve [carbon neutrality
by 2050][125], we are reducing global CO2 emissions by increasing the use of bio-renewable and
recyclable materials, while promoting the value of these activities throughout the supply chain. Our
emphasis on sustainability continues to be fundamental to our innovation and product development and
is gaining broad support from our customers.

[ [SunChemical-Sustainability-Report-Covers] ][126]

#### [ Download Our Latest Sustainability Report ][127]

Every year we publish a [sustainability report][128] which shows our progress in achieving our
eco-efficiency goals and helps us establish actions to improve, recheck and remeasure.

[ [coffee-flexible-packaging-transforms-into-owl] ][129]

#### [ Experience. Transformation. ][130]

As the [packaging market transforms][131] its packaging toward sustainability, use our 200+ years of
experience to help your packaging become bio-renewable, compostable or recyclable.

[ [Sustainable-Growth-Guide-Cover] ][132]

#### [ Sustainable Growth with the "5Rs" ][133]

Sun Chemical has produced *[Sustainable Growth][134] *– a guide to help you grow your business
sustainably and contribute to the circular economy. The guide is centered around five “Rs” — Reuse,
Reduce, Renew, Recycle, and Redesign. 

## Explore Career Opportunities at Sun Chemical

Looking for a fulfilling career with Sun Chemical? Take a look at the [career opportunities][135]
available to you and get a feel for what it’s like working at Sun Chemical.
[#lifeatsunchemical][136]

## Want More Information?

Have questions or comments about our products, services, safety data sheets (SDS / MSDS) or product
data sheets (TDS)? Get in touch!

[Contact Us][137]
