# Sun Chemical is the World’s Leading Provider of Inks and Pressroom Products, Color Materials and
# Advanced Materials

### Experience. Transformation.

Beginning with the inspiring legacy of Lorilleux and Samuel Morrill in the early 1800’s, Sun
Chemical has delivered [over 200 years][114] of color expertise, innovative technology and an
ongoing commitment to quality and service for our customers.

A member of the DIC Group, Sun Chemical is a leading producer of packaging and graphic solutions,
color and display technologies, functional products, electronic materials, and products for the
automotive and healthcare industries.

Together with DIC, Sun Chemical’s 21,000+ employees are continuously working to promote and develop
sustainable solutions to exceed customer expectations and better the world around us. Spread across
17 [research and development][115] centers worldwide, we’ve been granted over 3,000 patents and are
determined to deliver the solutions you need.


## Sun Chemical's Products and Solutions

#### [ Packaging and Graphic Solutions ][116]

Sun Chemical is a recognized leader in[ printing inks, coatings, adhesives and supplies][117] for
the packaging, publication, commercial, industrial, and digital markets and introduces solutions
that enable marketers to better manage their brand colors, protect product integrity through
improvements in packaging, and introduce security features that defend against counterfeiting.

#### [ Color Materials ][118]

Sun Chemical develops a wide range of [pigments and color materials][119] for architectural,
automotive and industrial coatings, cosmetics, plastics, printing inks, agricultural, and more.
Combining its pigments with DIC’s polymers for the same industries can create superior benefits and
value for coatings formulators.

#### [ Advanced Materials ][120]

Sun Chemical and DIC produce a variety of [advanced materials][121], including liquid compounds,
solid compounds and application materials for printed circuits, printed electronics, solar modules,
digital inkjet printing, automotive components, adhesives, magnetic tapes for plastic cards and
degasification modules.

#### [ Sun Chemical Security ][122]

[Sun Chemical Security][123] is our dedicated global security solutions business unit focused on
providing a wide-range of high-quality security solutions to help protect your products from
counterfeiters.

## Sun Chemical's Unwavering Focus on Sustainability

#### Learn How Sun Chemical is Prioritizing Sustainability

Sun Chemical is constantly working to promote sustainable solutions. [Our approach][124] to
sustainability guides the way we develop, manufacture and distribute products, as well as how we
work with our customers and suppliers.

Working with industry leaders and in line with DIC Corporation’s goal to achieve [carbon neutrality
by 2050][125], we are reducing global CO2 emissions by increasing the use of bio-renewable and
recyclable materials, while promoting the value of these activities throughout the supply chain. Our
emphasis on sustainability continues to be fundamental to our innovation and product development and
is gaining broad support from our customers.

[ [SunChemical-Sustainability-Report-Covers] ][126]

#### [ Download Our Latest Sustainability Report ][127]

Every year we publish a [sustainability report][128] which shows our progress in achieving our
eco-efficiency goals and helps us establish actions to improve, recheck and remeasure.

[ [coffee-flexible-packaging-transforms-into-owl] ][129]

#### [ Experience. Transformation. ][130]

As the [packaging market transforms][131] its packaging toward sustainability, use our 200+ years of
experience to help your packaging become bio-renewable, compostable or recyclable.

[ [Sustainable-Growth-Guide-Cover] ][132]

#### [ Sustainable Growth with the "5Rs" ][133]

Sun Chemical has produced *[Sustainable Growth][134] *– a guide to help you grow your business
sustainably and contribute to the circular economy. The guide is centered around five “Rs” — Reuse,
Reduce, Renew, Recycle, and Redesign. 

## Explore Career Opportunities at Sun Chemical

Looking for a fulfilling career with Sun Chemical? Take a look at the [career opportunities][135]
available to you and get a feel for what it’s like working at Sun Chemical.

## Innovative Packaging Solutions Tailored to Your Needs

At Sunkey Packaging, we offer a range of specialized solutions designed to meet the unique demands
of your products. From creative packaging designs to advanced material research, our expertise
ensures your products stand out and perform at their best.

  Our R&D team is dedicated to developing advanced materials that meet the highest standards of

* Functional Realization
  We provide packaging solutions that offer more than just protection, adding value through
  functionality such as easy opening, resealability, and enhanced product shelf life.
* Reduce Costs
  Sunkey, as a group of companies, includes the whole chain of film making - printing - laminating -
  slitting - bag making to minimize your cost, and can provide cost reduction flexible plastic
  packaging solutions through its rich experience.
* Material Research
  The Institute of Composite Packaging Materials was established in cooperation with Jiangnan
  University. The institute has many doctoral and master's degree students, specializing in new
  material development and research, and invests tens of millions of dollars every year.
* Equipment Design
  Our expertise extends to designing packaging equipment that integrates seamlessly with your

# About us

UFlex is India’s largest multinational flexible packaging and solutions company. Our packaging
excellence has positioned us as a preferred packaging solutions company amongst global brands
worldwide. Over the last three decades, we have earned an irreproachable reputation by defining the
contours of the packaging industry in India and overseas. As a leading name among packaging
solutions companies, we assist our customers by offering world-class packaging solutions that
preserve freshness and extend shelf-life of food and other packed products. Owing to our qualitative
approach, we are recognized as a pre-eminent player amongst flexible packaging companies in India.
Since our inception in 1985, we have turned into a multi-billion company by focusing on trust, value
creation for customers, quality innovation and customer satisfaction.

[Read More][82]

 

[About us] [[UFlex Limited Corporate Video]][83]

**Trust:** We ensure trust remains at the core at every point of service and customer interaction.
We take stringent steps to provide consistent quality to earn our customer's faith.

**Quality Innovation:**We embrace quality innovation in our work style. Our efforts are aligned
towards developing responsible packaging solutions that meet the customer’s business goals. We are
dedicated to revolutionising food packaging sentiment in India and abroad with our value-added
innovations.

**Value creation for customers:** We strive to persistently work towards developing leading-edge
packaging designs to provide additional value to our customer's products. Whether it is food
packaging or manufacturing packaging applications for other sectors, we excel by creating value for
customers at every step. Our expertise in food packaging has placed us as the most preferred food
packaging manufacturers in India.

**Customer Satisfaction:**We believe in sharing long-lasting relationships with our customers. At
all times, we make sure not to lose sight for minute details for common good.

With a belief in manufacturing and providing cutting-edge packaging solutions, we have grown from
strength to strength. We have an extensive range of manufacturing capacity of packaging films,
flexible packaging, printing, and other value-added packaging applications that cater to our clients
spread across 140 countries. We enjoy a formidable market presence, thereby becoming India’s largest
flexible packaging manufacturer and one of the most reliable **flexible packaging companies in
India.**

Our commitment to the industry is visible in our all-out efforts to provide technical know-how and
thereby establish thought leadership. With more than thirty years of experience in polymer
technology, we have mastered flexible packaging solutions that meet our client's flexible packaging
requirements.

UFlex is one of the world’s leading organizations providing brand protection and anti-counterfeiting

##### Flexible packaging

UFlex is the largest Flexible Packaging Exporter with manufacturing capacity of over 80000 TPA.

##### Printing cylinders

UFlex Printing Cylinders Business has a State-of-the-art manufacturing facility for producing

[VIEW MORE][91]
[Engineering Business]

##### Engineering

Engineering Business of UFlex has grown to be the manufacturing major of top of the line packaging,

[VIEW MORE][92]

### Investors

UFlex is a leading Indian Multinational focusing on innovation to create differentiation, proximity
to customers and holistic end-to-end flexible packaging solutions. All efforts at the organization
are aimed at augmenting the shareholders’ value.

[View More][93]

### New innovation

[Up to 100% PCR Film ‘Asclepius™’]

#### [ Asclepius™ (Upto 100% PCR Film)][94]

UFlex’ upto 100% PCR polymer content BOPET film offers substantial reduction in carbon footprint and
comes with higher sustainability levels and significantly lower net energy requirement for
production when compared to virgin BOPET grades. The film is marketed under the brand name
Ascelpius™.

[Film for ISRO]

#### [Satellite Thermal Insulation Film for ISRO][95]

UFlex developed specialised Satellite Thermal Radiation Insulation Film for Indian Space Programme
by Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO).

[RELAM 250]

#### [RELAM 250 (MLP Recycling Machine)][96]

The RELAM250 machine is designed to recycle industrial plastic flexible waste into granulated
products that can be used for various economically valuable moulded products. RELAM 250 offers ease
of handling of any combination or mixture of multi layered plastic without the need for separation.

[4D Bags with Handle]

#### [4D Bags (Re-closable with Handle ) ][97]

UFlex’ 4D bags are brick shaped bags on all sides with a handle. UFlex’ 4D Bags re-closable and can
stand or lie on its belly. The innovative 4D bags combine the stand-ability and shelf prominence
rigid with functionality of flexible packaging. It is an ideal packaging solution for granular
products like Rice, Coffee, Tea, Detergents, Pet food etc.

[Printing of MICR Instruments]

#### [Printing of MICR Instruments (IBA Certified Partner)][98]

MICR, (Magnetic Ink Character Recognition) instruments requires special printing system with overt
and covert features for bank cheques, legal tenders and various other negotiable documents.  UFlex
is Indian Banks’ Association (IBA) certified partner for printing of MICR instruments.

[Kraftika By Flexitube]

#### [Kraftika (Eco-friendly Paper tube with Reduced Plastic)][99]

Kraftika is an Eco-friendly Paper based tube that involves replacing of plastic with a virgin kraft
paper by upto 70% thereby reducing plastic input at source. KRAFTIKA is best suited for packaging of
Oral Care, Cosmetics including Face Wash, gets, cream etc.

[Flexgreen Inline Gloss Coating – HRK9542]

#### [HRK9542 (Flexgreen Inline Gloss Coating)][100]

HRK9542 - Flexgreen Inline Gloss Coating is a UV LED coating for inline applications for gravure
jobs, especially on paperfoil laminates substrate and laminated board for sheetfed printing. The
coating is applied to impart glossy and smooth appearance, apart from their visual effects and
offers good processing, high reactivity and a good flow-out.

[Asepto Premium Foil Stamping Effects]

#### [Asepto Premium (Foil Stamping Effects)][101]

Asepto Premium gives brands a great opportunity to increase their product lines without
contemplating about creating an urbane look for the packs. Asepto Premium foil stamping effect
redefines the making of carton packs into an art form with luxurious shiny finish which is a classy
way to present aseptic liquid packs on the shelves.

### New innovation

[Up to 100% PCR Film ‘Asclepius™’]

#### [ Asclepius™ (Upto 100% PCR Film)][94]

UFlex’ upto 100% PCR polymer content BOPET film offers substantial reduction in carbon footprint and
comes with higher sustainability levels and significantly lower net energy requirement for
production when compared to virgin BOPET grades. The film is marketed under the brand name
Ascelpius™.

[Film for ISRO]

#### [Satellite Thermal Insulation Film for ISRO][95]

UFlex developed specialised Satellite Thermal Radiation Insulation Film for Indian Space Programme
by Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO).

[RELAM 250]

#### [RELAM 250 (MLP Recycling Machine)][96]

The RELAM250 machine is designed to recycle industrial plastic flexible waste into granulated
products that can be used for various economically valuable moulded products. RELAM 250 offers ease
of handling of any combination or mixture of multi layered plastic without the need for separation.

[4D Bags with Handle]

#### [4D Bags (Re-closable with Handle ) ][97]

UFlex’ 4D bags are brick shaped bags on all sides with a handle. UFlex’ 4D Bags re-closable and can
stand or lie on its belly. The innovative 4D bags combine the stand-ability and shelf prominence
rigid with functionality of flexible packaging. It is an ideal packaging solution for granular
products like Rice, Coffee, Tea, Detergents, Pet food etc.

[Printing of MICR Instruments]

#### [Printing of MICR Instruments (IBA Certified Partner)][98]

MICR, (Magnetic Ink Character Recognition) instruments requires special printing system with overt
and covert features for bank cheques, legal tenders and various other negotiable documents.  UFlex
is Indian Banks’ Association (IBA) certified partner for printing of MICR instruments.

[Kraftika By Flexitube]

#### [Kraftika (Eco-friendly Paper tube with Reduced Plastic)][99]

Kraftika is an Eco-friendly Paper based tube that involves replacing of plastic with a virgin kraft
paper by upto 70% thereby reducing plastic input at source. KRAFTIKA is best suited for packaging of
Oral Care, Cosmetics including Face Wash, gets, cream etc.

[Flexgreen Inline Gloss Coating – HRK9542]

#### [HRK9542 (Flexgreen Inline Gloss Coating)][100]

HRK9542 - Flexgreen Inline Gloss Coating is a UV LED coating for inline applications for gravure
jobs, especially on paperfoil laminates substrate and laminated board for sheetfed printing. The
coating is applied to impart glossy and smooth appearance, apart from their visual effects and
offers good processing, high reactivity and a good flow-out.

[Asepto Premium Foil Stamping Effects]

#### [Asepto Premium (Foil Stamping Effects)][101]

Asepto Premium gives brands a great opportunity to increase their product lines without
contemplating about creating an urbane look for the packs. Asepto Premium foil stamping effect
redefines the making of carton packs into an art form with luxurious shiny finish which is a classy
way to present aseptic liquid packs on the shelves.

# The Premier Custom Packaging Manufacturer for Global Brands

Inconsistent quality, supply chain delays, and non-compliant packaging can severely derail your
brand’s growth and profitability. Backed by 29 years of excellence and 100+ automated production
machines, we provide scalable, reliable, and compliant custom packaging solutions designed
specifically for the rigorous demands of the USA and European markets.

## **6 Key Advantages of Our Factory**

Discover why global brands choose our one-stop paper packaging factory for custom boxes, bags,
tubes, cartons and printed packaging solutions.
[Packaging Service icon]

### One-Stop Paper Packaging Service

From paper material option to printing, production, completing and delivering, we streamline
custom-made product packaging sourcing via one experienced provider.
[Production Capability]

### Large-Scale Production Capability

Our 23,500 manufacturing facility supports high-volume paper packaging orders, helping brands safe
and secure stable result for seasonal launches and international programs.
[Engineering Support Icon]

### Engineering & Structural Support

Professional designers aid fine-tune box framework, product use and product packaging fit,
sustaining customized tasks from early principle to mass production.

packaging invest while keeping jobs sensible.
[Global Export Supply Icon]

With exports to 40+ nations and flexible lead times, we support international purchasers with
consistent product packaging supply and logistics control.
[Quality Team Icon]

### Quality & Service-Oriented Team

Our quality emphasis, reliable sales team and lasting service frame of mind assistance customers
decrease sourcing risk and construct reputable provider cooperation.

## **Who We Are: One-Stop Paper Packaging Manufacturer**

Our factory focuses on one-stop paper packaging service, covering product choice, architectural
style, printing, production and shipping. With a 23,500 production base, we are a major paper
packaging maker in China, offering brands, retailers, distributors and procurement teams with
effective, economical options.

Supported by specialist designers, an efficient sales group and competitive rates, we produce gift
boxes, folding containers, paper bags, paper tube boxes, corrugated cartons, present boxes and
printed packaging. Our products are exported to over 40 countries and regions, including Europe, the
United States, Australia, Russia, Mexico, Brazil, India, Thailand, the Center East and South Africa.

Our tools sustains graphic layout, E-color plating, color printing, self-adhesive handling,
polishing and rubber product design. We price estimate within 20 mins, deliver examples in 3– 5 days
and set up bulk shipment in 15– 22 days. With FSC, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and BSCI certificates, we
help brand names create lasting, reliable and competitive paper packaging.
[Get In Touch With Us][98]

Explore our custom paper packaging products for gifts, food, cosmetics, retail, e-commerce and
promotional packaging. From rigid boxes and folding cartons to paper bags, tubes and display
